head_commit.message:
Revert network module to pre-template-upgrade state

The template v0.15.7 upgrade restructured the network module and removed
support for database subnets, NAT gateways, and VPC endpoints. Applying
these changes would destroy critical shared networking infrastructure.

Reverts all network module files and networks/main.tf back to their main
branch versions to preserve existing resource addresses.
